name: @pipeworx/mcp-plausible

tools.name: plausible_overview
tools.description: Return aggregate visitors, visits, pageviews, bounce rate, visit duration, and optional goal revenue for a Plausible site. Answers how much traffic and engagement the site generated during a period.

site_id.description: Plausible site ID, usually the configured domain such as example.com

date_range.description: Plausible date range preset or a two-item ISO date array

include_revenue.description: Include total_revenue and average_revenue; use with a revenue goal filter

goal.description: Limit metrics to one configured goal display name

tools.name: plausible_timeseries
tools.description: Return bounded Plausible metrics grouped by day, week, month, or hour. Answers when traffic, engagement, conversions, or revenue changed during a period.

site_id.description: Plausible site ID, usually the configured domain such as example.com

date_range.description: Plausible date range preset or a two-item ISO date array

metrics.description: Plausible metric names; defaults to visitors and pageviews

goal.description: Limit metrics to one configured goal display name

tools.name: plausible_breakdown
tools.description: Return ranked Plausible metrics grouped by a page, source, campaign, geography, device, browser, or custom-property dimension. Answers which channels, content, audiences, or experiences drove results.

site_id.description: Plausible site ID, usually the configured domain such as example.com

date_range.description: Plausible date range preset or a two-item ISO date array

dimension.description: Plausible dimension such as visit:source, visit:utm_campaign, event:page, visit:country_name, or event:props:plan

metrics.description: Metrics; defaults to visitors and pageviews

tools.name: plausible_goal_performance
tools.description: Return events, visitors, and conversion rate grouped by configured Plausible goal. Answers which signup, activation, purchase, or other goals converted during a period.

site_id.description: Plausible site ID, usually the configured domain such as example.com

date_range.description: Plausible date range preset or a two-item ISO date array

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-plausible forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the plausible pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
